message.content: Add IMAGE RESIZING to the Nxeon webmail SIGNATURE editor in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15). Currently, when a user uploads/inserts an image into the rich signature editor it's inserted at `max-width:100%` and fills the whole editor with no way to make it smaller (see: a large logo dominating the signature box). Add an easy, reliable way to resize an inserted image. ## Study first (do NOT run git or `npm run build`) - `components/customer/mail/MailSettings.tsx` — the `contentEditable` signature editor + its toolbar (bold/italic/font/size/color/list/link/image/HR), the selection save/restore helpers (`saveSel`/`restoreSel`/`insertHtml`), the upload-from-PC image insert (inserts ``), and how the HTML is sanitized (`safeHtml`) + saved. - `lib/mail/render.ts` `safeHtml` — confirm inline `style` (esp. `width`/`max-width`) is preserved so the resized width survives save/preview/send. (It keeps `style`.) ## Implement — click-to-select + a size control (reliable, no library) 1. **Select an image**: clicking an `` inside the editor selects/highlights it (e.g. a subtle outline/ring) and remembers it as the "active image". Clicking elsewhere / typing deselects. Handle this with an editor-scoped click handler (don't rely on native image resize handles, which are inconsistent). 2. **Size control**: when an image is active, show a small, themed control (a compact floating toolbar near the image, or a row that appears under the main toolbar) with: - Preset buttons: **Small** (~150px), **Medium** (~320px), **Large** (~600px), **Full width** (100%). - A width **slider or number input** (px) for fine control (clamp e.g. 40–1000px). - Optional: an "original size" reset. Applying a size sets the image's inline `style` `width:px` (or `width:100%` for Full) and keeps `max-width:100%` and `height:auto` so it never overflows the email or distorts. Update live as the slider moves. 3. **Bonus if low-risk**: a bottom-right drag handle on the selected image to resize by dragging (mouse + pointer events, clamp min/max, preserve aspect via height:auto). If it adds much complexity or fragility, SKIP it — the presets + slider are the required, reliable path. 4. Ensure the width persists: it's part of the img's inline style, so it's saved with `signatureHtml`, survives `safeHtml`, and renders in the composer + outgoing mail. Deselect/clean up any editor-only selection styling before the HTML is read for save (don't persist a selection outline/handle into the stored signature). ## Constraints - No new npm deps (hand-roll it). Only touch `components/customer/mail/MailSettings.tsx` (and `lib/mail/render.ts` ONLY if `width` is being stripped and must be allowed — verify first; prefer not to touch it). Do NOT touch the migration, disk-usage/proxmox/monitor, billing, terminal, cpanel, or backup files. Do NOT run git or `npm run build`. - Keep it themed to the dark Nxeon UI; accessible (buttons focusable, the control keyboard-usable). The stored signature HTML must stay sanitized (no editor-only artifacts, no script/handlers). - Write/Edit may time out on a hook — fall back to Bash heredocs and verify. - Verify ONLY with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` (clean for your files). Report: the select-image interaction, the size control (presets + slider, and whether the drag handle was included), how the width persists through safeHtml into outgoing mail, and confirm no editor-only styling leaks into the saved signature.
